title: Welcome to Poketod SMP: The Ultimate Adventure
excerpt: Discover what awaits you in the new season of Poketod SMP, blending **Cobblemon** with **Create Aeronautics**.
content:
Welcome to Poketod SMP! We are thrilled to announce the launch of our new season.

### What's New?
We have integrated **Cobblemon** and **Create Aeronautics**, bringing you a unique experience where you can catch Pokémon and build steampunk airships to explore the skies.

### Join the Community
Don't forget to join our Discord server to connect with other players, participate in events, and share your creations. See you in the game!
author: Naotica
